sentences.en: No matter what you think, the verdict was not just.
sentences.zh: 无论你认为如何，这个裁定都是不公正的。

sentences.en: The jury's guilty verdict gave rise to widespread debate.
sentences.zh: 陪审团有罪的裁定引发了广泛讨论。

sentences.en: Her hopes were dashed when she heard the verdict.
sentences.zh: 她听到那个裁定后，所有的希望都破灭了。

senses.zh: (陪审团的)裁决, 裁定 - (经过试验、检验或体验发表的)决定, 意见

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ver（真实）+dict（说）→说出事实→裁定
